name: Watarase Yuki
source:
A member of the Nameless. She dressed as a man. Yuki is a modern-day fencer who is unusually strong. She was an orphan, but after some complicated circumstances, was adopted by lizardman [url=https://vndb.org/c40263]Gara Ra Redwood[/url]. After graduating from White Hands Academy, she was assigned as butler to the Foster family. She is a cheerful intellectual; mentally tough and patient; and fiercely loyal to [url=https://vndb.org/c40261]her master[/url]. She respects [url=https://vndb.org/c40263]Gara[/url] from the bottom of her heart and does her best to not tarnish his name.

[Translated from [url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/will_0114/]DMMStore[/url]]
